method: Each measure in the budget's chapter summary tables, net of the 'Less:' lines under it, is shared among ridings by one key. pop: by population. prov: by population within the named provinces. dept: by each riding's share of that department's grants and contributions in the two years around the 2025 election (both windows). cdept: by that department's contracts since the election. places: equally among the ridings of the named places. excluded: savings, revenues, accounting lines and money spent abroad are listed but not placed.
